s: to take (something into one's possession or on one's body)
transitive
Wer hat meinen Hut genommen?
Who took my hat?
to take from
Die Niederlage nahm der Mannschaft den Mut.
The team's defeat robbed them of their courage.
to hold (in one's hands), to grasp
transitive
Hier, nimm meine Hand.
Here, take my hand.
to take, to consider (a statement, a situation, an idea, etc, in a certain way, for example seriously, badly, personally)
transitive
Die Polizei nimmt die Angriffe ernst.
The police are taking the attacks seriously.
Ich nehme diese Bemerkung übel.
I resent (take as offensive) that remark.
to capture, to arrest
transitive
Die Verbrecher wurden in Gewahrsam genommen.
The criminals were taken into custody.
to ingest (e.g. a pill)
transitive
Nimm etwas Aspirin, wenn du Kopfschmerzen hast.
Take some aspirin if you have a headache.
to move into, to sit at (one's assigned position)
transitive
Meine Damen und Herren, bitte nehmen Sie Ihre Plätze.
Ladies and gentlemen, please take your seats.
to use (time, effort, etc. for a specific purpose)
reflexive
transitive
Du solltest dir etwas Zeit nehmen, um dich zu entspannen.
You should take some time to relax.
To begin or cause the action implied by a noun to take place, possibly making the sentence more passive or indirect.
transitive
Abschied nehmen
to say goodbye
Abstand nehmen
to refrain
to cause oneself to be (in some state); to become; to take oneself (to some state)
reflexive
Nimm dich in Acht!
Take care!
to seize, to capture
transitive
to receive, to accept
transitive
nehmen.et:
Inherited from Middle High German nëmen, from Old High German nëman, from Proto-West Germanic *neman, from Proto-Germanic *nemaną, from Proto-Indo-European *nem- (“to give or take one's due”).
Cognate with Low German nehmen (“to take”), Dutch nemen (“to take”)…

From East Prussian Middle High German nerunge, neringe (“spit”, 15th c.), earlier nerige, nerge (14th c.). Cognate with Old Prussian neria, Lithuanian nerija (both “spit”). Further origin uncertain.
* Assuming German origin, from the adjective Proto-Germanic *…
